title: Satisfiability of Equality Equations
statement: Each equation is four characters: a lowercase letter, then == or !=, then another lowercase letter. Decide whether integers can be assigned to the letters so that every equation holds at once.
constraints: each equation has the form "a==b" or "a!=b"
hints: Equality is transitive and inequality is not, so the two kinds of equation are not symmetric. Order matters.
Merge everything the equalities force to be equal first, then check the inequalities against the result.
Union the == pairs into 26 disjoint sets, then a != pair is a contradiction exactly when both letters landed in the same set.
